title: Common DICTIONARY typed callback retention bounds
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound the common DRW_Dictionary list callback and named-object-root callback under one aggregate adapter budget
Account for base table-entry dynamic state, dictionary entry slots, and entry-name payloads
Mark incomplete active DXF associative capture when a common dictionary callback cannot be retained
Fail export before output publication on any common dictionary capture failure
Add generated fast coverage for exact shared admission, deep-copy independence, per-dimension over-budget refusal, and destination preservation

controls: The ordinary dictionary list and named-object root consume the same lifetime record/entry/byte budget
Exact-fit aggregate limits admit both destination types
Over-budget record, entry, and byte attempts refuse further copies and preserve previously admitted state
The DXF export guard reports typed dictionary capture failure and preserves an existing destination sentinel
implementation.limitations: This admission bound does not establish dictionary ownership/reference closure, source graph completeness, serializer fidelity, or native application acceptance.

localEvidence: The common callbacks previously copied directly to dx_data::dictionaries and dx_data::namedObjectDictionary without a shared adapter admission budget.
The new guard is generated entirely from in-memory C++ dictionary values and a temporary output sentinel; no persistent or downloaded drawing fixture was added.
Existing extension graph and DICTIONARYWDFLT/PLACEHOLDER focused tests passed with the new guard.
